title: Generative AI Bootcamp
metadec: AI  Risezonic Generative AI Bootcamp is an in-depth program that provides hands-on training, deep learning frameworks, and the creation of generative models.
overview: Dive deep into the world of Generative AI through real-world projects and hands-on training. This bootcamp covers everything from prompt engineering to building AI applications using the latest LLM technologies.
details: Understand the core concepts of Generative AI and large language models (LLMs)
Learn prompt engineering techniques to maximize AI outputs
Build real-time AI chatbots and assistants using OpenAI and HuggingFace
Fine-tune open-source models for specific business or academic use-cases
Deploy AI tools using LangChain, FastAPI, and Gradio

title: IoT & Robotics Camp
metadec: AI Risezonic Provide an educational robotics summer camp with IoT projects, coding, robot-building, and innovation for young learners. Enroll now!
overview: Dive into the exciting future of connected devices and smart automation systems! In this camp you'll get exposure to IoT systems, robotics programming, sensor integration, and working with real hardware and automation.
details: Learn how real IoT devices communicate using sensors and microcontrollers
Build and control robots with Arduino and Raspberry Pi.
Integrate AI and machine learning into robots and robotics applications.
Visualize, monitor, and analyze data in real time with dashboards and cloud services.
Create practical projects for automation and robotics.

title: Power BI Course Mastery Workshop
metadec: Transform your data skills with our Power BI Workshop. Gain hands-on experience and learn to create impactful visualizations. Enroll now!
overview: Gain practical skills in business analytics and data visualization with the Microsoft Power BI course. This workshop is designed for professionals looking to transform raw data into powerful insights and reports.
details: Connect, clean, and transform data with Power Query
Create professional dashboards and visuals efficiently
Excel at Data Analysis Expressions (DAX) for advanced data modeling and KPIs
Deploy and share interactive reports using Power BI Service
Use Power BI for real-world application business scenarios
